name: clatter-shake
title: Clatter Shake
description: A hanging tag drops in on its string and clatters side to side until it hangs still. Pure CSS keyframes, played once on mount.
label: yui540/css-animations
author: yui540 <https://github.com/yui540>

props.name: children
props.description: Content shown on the tag, below its hole (a short label or an icon). With children, the root is no longer aria-hidden.

props.name: key
props.description: Change it to remount and play the animation again.

props.name: ...props
props.description: Every native div attribute. className sizes the stage (default w-full max-w-80, square); aria-label names it.

a11y: Decorative by default: the root is aria-hidden. Pass aria-label (or aria-labelledby) and it becomes role="img" with that name.
Right to left: the figure is mirrored, so it moves toward the reading direction.
Reduced motion: no motion; the tag hangs at rest.
usage: <ClatterShake key={run} aria-label="A hanging tag swinging to a stop" />
